wafProbeResult: No vendor WAF marker (no cf-ray / x-sucuri / incap / Akamai). Fastly CDN headers only. Rule-selective layer fires 406/400 on SQLi/XSS payloads while normal traffic passes 200. Honeypot paths 404 (not 403). Rapid burst (10x ~2s) all 200. Multi-UA all 200. No CAPTCHA gate on homepage.

wafProbeEvidence.interpretation: no vendor WAF; Magento/Fastly app-layer rule-selective on injection payloads only

watermark.reason: Searchspring sort.created_at=desc verified honored via 3-outcome counter-control test (default first3 != newest first3 != price-asc first3). No queryable date-range filter found on created_at (filter.created_at.low/high return 0), so api-date-since-watermark not viable; navigate-from-watermark with newest sort proves the watermark crawl.

topLevelCategories.totalsSumCheck: Sum of 8 top-level categories = 19,781. Global Searchspring unfiltered total = 18,916. Sum > global by 4.6% indicates multi-parent tagging (e.g. women's hunting jacket appears in both Women and Hunting). Sitemap product-URL count = 18,944 (0.15% above global). Drift acceptable.
topLevelCategories.notes: Seasonal/aggregator URLs (Sales, Clearance, Flash Sale, Door Crashers, Mothers' Day, etc.) intentionally excluded from catalogUrls because they overlap entirely with the per-category list. 'Gift Ideas' (227) is a curated subset — every product also lives in a top-level dpt category. 'DEV' (20) is a dev sandbox.

fieldConfidence.catalogUrls: medium (8 top-levels from facet; multi-parent overlap not perfectly partitionable; coverage acceptable)
fieldConfidence.perPage: high (verified server returns 100 cleanly; caps silently at 100 above)

openQuestions: Magento-2.x catalog pages do not server-render product cards — Searchspring SPA replaces innerHTML on load. Project crawler must either (a) drive Playwright on /en/<category> URLs and wait for Searchspring DOM, or (b) call Searchspring API directly via bootstrap.apiEndpoints. Recommend the latter for efficiency.
Stock status not present in Searchspring lite result objects — would need a second per-product call OR fetch the detail page. Detail-page maintain verify path covers this.
Locale: site exposes both /en/ and /fr/ sitemaps and content. Only /en/ in scope for this profile.
